videos.title: Lam：鉬金屬化與 ALTUS Halo
watchFor: 互連縮小時需要重新評估材料，而非只縮小幾何。
鉬是此產品案例的材料；不能直接套用到銅、鈷、釕或鎢課程。
比較電阻、薄膜沉積與整合限制，分開供應商說明及自己的驗證。
watchForEn: Shrinking interconnects requires reconsidering material choices, not only geometry.
Molybdenum belongs to this product case; do not transfer it directly to copper, cobalt, ruthenium or tungsten lessons.
Compare resistance, deposition and integration constraints while separating vendor statements from your verification.
videos.scope: 本課「銅雙鑲嵌互連」的延伸背景。用鉬 ALD 案例比較金屬互連材料轉換；不是其他金屬的通用配方。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Copper dual-damascene interconnects. Use the molybdenum-ALD case to compare interconnect material transitions; it is not a universal recipe for other metals. It is not footage of every step in this course.

guides.title: 銅雙鑲嵌互連：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Copper dual-damascene interconnects: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」建立判讀邊界。垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a via and trench between metal levels to define the interpretation boundary. Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充：超共形填充可避免過早封口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查：局部製程合格仍需跨層功能驗證。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a via and trench between metal levels: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: Superconformal fill can avoid premature closure. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a two-level RC and failure review: Local process acceptance still needs cross-layer functional validation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a two-level RC and failure review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「表面平坦可排除內部空洞。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A planar surface rules out internal voids.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 銅雙鑲嵌互連涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用imec 魯汶研究園區（Tower 代表點）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Copper dual-damascene interconnects involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses imec Leuven research campus: Tower reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.
